mapper.select: SELECT recovery_id,direction,source_record_id,business_intent_key,state, attempt_count,next_attempt_at,last_error_code,last_error_summary, dead_lettered_at,recovery_required_at,replay_count,last_replayed_at, last_replayed_by_type,last_replayed_by_id,last_replay_reason, last_replay_correlation_id,resolved_at,lock_version,created_at,updated_at FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT recovery_id,direction,source_record_id,business_intent_key,state,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,last_error_code,last_error_summary,dead_lettered_at,recovery_required_at,replay_count,last_replayed_at,last_replayed_by_type,last_replayed_by_id,last_replay_reason,last_replay_correlation_id,resolved_at,lock_version,created_at,updated_at FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction=#{direction} AND state=#{state} AND dead_lettered_at IS NOT NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND last_error_code=#{error} AND recovery_required_at >= #{from} AND recovery_required_at <= #{to} AND dead_lettered_at IS NOT NULL AND (dead_lettered_atrecovery_required_at > < #{cursorTime} OR (dead_lettered_atrecovery_required_at=#{cursorTime} AND recovery_id > < #{cursorId})) ORDER BY dead_lettered_atrecovery_required_at ASC DESC,recovery_id ASC DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT inbox_id,message_id,business_intent_key,contract_ref,contract_version, body_bytes,body_sha256,correlation_id,causation_id,occurred_at,status,lock_version FROM inbox_message WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND inbox_id=#{inboxId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.outbox_id,o.contract_ref,o.contract_version,o.aggregate_id, o.correlation_id,o.status,o.lock_version, l.status AS link_status,COALESCE(l.lock_version,0) AS link_lock_version FROM outbox_event o LEFT JOIN workflow_start_link l ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.ticket_id=o.aggregate_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.outbox_id=#{outboxId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING',attempt_count=0,next_attempt_at=#{now}, locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,broker_confirmed_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED' AND lock_version=#{lockVersion}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='OPEN',next_attempt_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{error}, last_error_summary='Controlled same-path replay did not reach a local terminal result.', lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND state='REPLAYING' AND last_replay_correlation_id=#{attemptCorrelation} AND next_attempt_at=#{leaseUntil}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',next_attempt_at=NULL,resolved_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND direction='INBOX' AND state='REPLAYING' AND last_replay_correlation_id=#{attemptCorrelation} AND next_attempt_at=#{leaseUntil}
